# WPS 600-699 OOP

Every violation in the OOP group of wemake-python-styleguide 1.8.1, from its [docs](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html).
Disabled ones are struck through.

| Code | Violation | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WPS600 | [BuiltinSubclassViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.BuiltinSubclassViolation) | Forbid subclassing lowercase builtins. |
| WPS601 | [ShadowedClassAttributeViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.ShadowedClassAttributeViolation) | Forbid shadowing class level attributes with instance level attributes. |
| WPS602 | [StaticMethodViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.StaticMethodViolation) | Forbid `@staticmethod` decorator. |
| WPS603 | [BadMagicMethodViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.BadMagicMethodViolation) | Forbid certain magic methods. |
| WPS604 | [WrongClassBodyContentViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.WrongClassBodyContentViolation) | Forbid incorrect nodes inside `class` definitions. |
| WPS605 | [MethodWithoutArgumentsViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.MethodWithoutArgumentsViolation) | Forbid methods without any arguments. |
| WPS606 | [WrongBaseClassViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.WrongBaseClassViolation) | Forbid anything other than a class as a base class. |
| WPS607 | [WrongSlotsViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.WrongSlotsViolation) | Forbid incorrect `__slots__` definition. |
| WPS608 | [WrongSuperCallViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.WrongSuperCallViolation) | Forbid `super()` with parameters or outside of methods. |
| WPS609 | ~~[DirectMagicAttributeAccessViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.DirectMagicAttributeAccessViolation)~~ disabled since 1.0.0 | Forbid directly calling certain magic attributes and methods. |
| WPS610 | [AsyncMagicMethodViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.AsyncMagicMethodViolation) | Forbid certain async magic methods. |
| WPS611 | [YieldMagicMethodViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.YieldMagicMethodViolation) | Forbid `yield` inside of certain magic methods. |
| WPS612 | [UselessOverwrittenMethodViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.UselessOverwrittenMethodViolation) | Forbid useless overwritten methods. |
| WPS613 | [WrongSuperCallAccessViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.WrongSuperCallAccessViolation) | Forbid `super()` with incorrect method or property access. |
| WPS614 | [WrongDescriptorDecoratorViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.WrongDescriptorDecoratorViolation) | Forbids descriptors in regular functions. |
| WPS615 | [UnpythonicGetterSetterViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.UnpythonicGetterSetterViolation) | Forbids to use getters and setters in objects. |
| WPS616 | [BuggySuperContextViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.BuggySuperContextViolation) | Calling super() in buggy context. |
| WPS617 | [LambdaAttributeAssignedViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/oop.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.oop.LambdaAttributeAssignedViolation) | Forbid using `lambda` as an assigned attribute. |
